verdicts.claim: Every genesis card’s mind, expressed from the recipe it carries on the published bytes, scores exactly the GATE AUC the drop manifest declares, to the millionth.
verdicts.saw: 1000 of 1000 minds scored exactly their declared GATE

verdicts.claim: Every one of those expressions runs with the network trapped and never reaches for it.
verdicts.saw: 1000 of 1000 expressed with the network trapped; 0 reached for it

verdicts.claim: On every twentieth genesis card, the search the manifest names, run again from nothing, finds exactly the mind the card carries.
verdicts.saw: 50 of 50 searches, re-run from nothing, found the very same mind

verdicts.claim: For each bundled set, a file with one byte changed is refused before a row of it is read.

verdicts.claim: At least 99% of genesis cards score above a coin (AUC > 0.5) on TEST, cases nothing in the build ever fitted or selected on.
verdicts.saw: 1000 of 1000 above a coin on TEST
